evals.prompt: Plan the target phrase and intent for a new wugweb.com service page on booking-system design.
evals.expected_output: One primary phrase and up to three supporting phrases, each with a source or marked unvalidated; the search intent; an outline of topics in order, not headings; the title and description limits; the schema; the link rules. No drafted copy.
expectations: Names one primary phrase and up to three supporting phrases
Gives each phrase a source or marks it unvalidated
Returns an outline of topics, not headings or wording
States the link rules and the schema and writes no copy

evals.prompt: Give a keyword note for a LinkedIn post title and tags about a care-booking case study.
evals.expected_output: Terms for the title, the first line and the tags, each sourced or marked unvalidated; tags few and specific; the post itself is not written and there is no hashtag stuffing.
expectations: Suggests title, first-line and tag terms, sourced or unvalidated
Keeps tags few and specific
Does not write the post and does not stuff hashtags

evals.prompt: Audit the title and meta description of a case-study page.
evals.expected_output: Reports the rendered title against 60 characters and a case-study source title against 51, and the description against 140 to 160; reports findings and never invents one.
expectations: Checks rendered title at 60 or fewer and case-study source at 51 or fewer
Checks the description is 140 to 160 characters
Reports only what it finds and invents nothing

evals.prompt: Check the JSON-LD on a case-study page.
evals.expected_output: Confirms WebPage, CreativeWork and BreadcrumbList with Wugweb as creator and publisher and no author; flags any HowTo, Review or AggregateRating; checks the graph parses and uses the schema.org context.
expectations: Requires WebPage, CreativeWork and BreadcrumbList on a case study
Requires creator and publisher and no author
Flags HowTo, Review and AggregateRating as banned

evals.prompt: Score this case-study page for the focus keyphrase care booking.
evals.expected_output: A per-test breakdown with points, a total from 0 to 100 and a grade (bad 50 or less, ok 51 to 80, great over 80); keyword density is scored; the score reports and writes no copy.
expectations: Returns a per-test breakdown and a 0 to 100 total with a grade
Scores keyword density, keyword in a subheading and title readability
Writes no copy and hands fixes to wugweb-work or a developer

evals.prompt: Does robots.txt let the AI answer bots reach /work/care-booking?
evals.expected_output: Resolves each named bot for the path; search and citation bots must be allowed; training bots are the owner's choice, reported and asked once per property.
expectations: Resolves each named bot against the path
Requires search and citation bots to be allowed
Treats training bots as the owner's choice, asked once

evals.prompt: Organic traffic to the blog dropped last month. Diagnose it.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the drop is real first, then checks in order tracking, indexing, robots.txt or a deploy, a search-engine update, a results feature, a competitor, then content decay; names the source and dates of every number or marks them unvalidated.
expectations: Confirms the drop is real before diagnosing
Follows the fixed check order for a drop
Names source and dates or marks numbers unvalidated

evals.prompt: Report Wugweb's presence in AI answers this month.
evals.expected_output: Uses a fixed monthly prompt sample, runs each prompt several times, records cited, mentioned or absent per prompt and how often Wugweb appears, and reads the trend over months.
expectations: Uses a fixed monthly prompt sample
Runs each prompt several times and reports how often Wugweb appears
Reads the trend across months, not a single run
